Prosecutrix is a major married woman having children.
However, the prosecutrix never complaint to her family members or lodged any report in police station.
The prosecutrix lodged the report only after when the applicant got engaged with another woman.
At the most, this is a case of consensual relationship and ingredients of Section 376(2)
(n) of IPC are not attracted.
The applicant is a Government Servant and in case, h e will arrest, then his entire career would be spoiled.
He has not criminal history.
opennyai_summary.20_April_2023__decision:

The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
